setup: Two similar triangles have corresponding sides in the ratio \([[factor]]\) to 1.

steps.say: Similar figures have every pair of corresponding sides in the same ratio, so the one ratio applies to all three pairs rather than to some of them.
Corresponding sides are the ones between the same two angles, which is what makes the multiplier \([[factor]]\) the right one to use here.

answer: So the corresponding side of the larger triangle is \([[side]]\).
